later_review_audit.description: Chatbox’s updater constructor enables automatic downloading and installation on quit. This supports those defaults in the inspected source; the asserted Windows code-signature setting remains unresolved.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than historical release re-verification; the updater module's full configuration, packaging metadata, and external electron-updater enforcement were not independently established.

original_evidence.text: | Chatbox (Community Edition) | Bin-Huang/chatbox | Electron (`electron-updater`) | Y | **Y — fully automatic**: `autoDownload=true` and `autoInstallOnAppQuit=true` set unconditionally at construction; a background timer additionally checks on startup (+5s) and then hourly when the user's `autoUpdate` setting is on | Y — auto-downloaded and, per `autoInstallOnAppQuit=true`, installed automatically when the app next quits (in addition to the manual "install-update" IPC path) | HTTPS; tries an ordered list of 5 feed-URL hostnames (`chatboxai.app`, `api.chatboxai.app`, `api.ai-chatbox.com`, `api.chatboxapp.xyz`, `api.chatboxai.com`) until one responds | N — same as above, `electron-updater`'s manifest is unsigned | hash-from-manifest (sha512 in the fetched update manifest) **+ OS code-signing at install** (custom Windows signer `custom_win_sign.js`; macOS notarization via `.erb/scripts/notarize.js`) — **same `verifyUpdateCodeSignature: false` weakening on Windows as Cherry Studio** | Windows signing cert used by `custom_win_sign.js` (not inspected further); Apple Developer ID via `@electron/notarize` | `src/main/app-updater.ts:26-27` (`autoDownload=true`, `autoInstallOnAppQuit=true`); `src/main/app-updater.ts:84-92` (5s + hourly auto-check loop); `src/main/app-updater.ts:103-109` (multi-host feed URL fallback list); `electron-builder.yml:24` (`notarize: false`), `electron-builder.yml:52` (`verifyUpdateCodeSignature: false`), `electron-builder.yml:85-86` (`publish: provider: s3`) |
